purpose: Teach: チューナー/チェックポイント/オペレーター/コントローラー/ビデオテープ/サイコロ/バーナー/ホーン

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、無線チューナーの周波数を毎日校正されますね
lines.en: The police calibrate their radio frequencies every day, don't they?
lines.style: Curious, matter-of-fact observation. Warm interest in the procedural detail. Light, conversational—like he's asking something he genuinely wonders about. Slightly building toward the next thought.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、高速のチェックポイントで検問もされますね
lines.en: And they run checkpoint inspections on the expressway too, right?
lines.style: Following naturally from the previous thought. Same warm curiosity. Slightly more engaged—he's building a picture of their work. Easy, collaborative tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急通報のオペレーター訓練もされますね
lines.en: They also do operator training for emergency calls, I imagine?
lines.style: Continuing the thread with genuine interest. Slightly softer—recognizing the weight of that particular role. Still conversational, not lecturing. Respectful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査車両のコントローラー保守もされますね
lines.en: And maintenance on the control systems for investigation vehicles as well?
lines.style: Maintaining the steady pace of discovery. Warm, genuinely interested in how these systems work. Not rhetorical—actually asking, actually listening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、古い証拠映像のビデオテープを保存されますね
lines.en: They keep old evidence footage too—videotapes and all, I suppose?
lines.style: Slight shift toward appreciating the thoroughness of it all. Gentle, understanding tone. A touch of wonder at the care involved in preservation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、訓練でサイコロを使うシナリオもされますね
lines.en: And training scenarios—those sometimes use dice to randomize situations, don't they?
lines.style: Lighter now. Noticing the ingenuity in how they prepare. Engaged but relaxed. The tone of someone appreciating a clever approach.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、火災現場でバーナー痕跡を鑑識されますね
lines.en: At fire scenes too—they examine burn marks for forensic evidence?
lines.style: Sobering slightly. Still curious but with more weight. Recognizing the serious investigative work that happens at scenes like that. Respectful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急時の車両ホーンを使い分けされますね
lines.en: And they know how to use different horn signals for emergencies, naturally.
lines.style: Settling into a conclusion. Warm, understanding, final-sounding. The tone of someone who's come to appreciate how much training and care goes into the work. Calm certainty.
